description: A report object provides supplemental information about a report

cardKey.description: Used to override the default cardKey, which is the cardKey of the card, in which the report macro is used

field.description: The full name of the field, for example base/fieldTypes/adoptionStep

identifier.description: Optional. The base/fieldTypes/identifier of the card in the current development project that has the field. Without it, the report shows the field of the card given by cardKey.

display.description: inline (default) shows the value within a line. row shows the label and the value as a block of their own.

title: Report
